correctness.rationale: The frozen Petersen KG(5,2) model has 10 vertices and 15 undirected edges, bidirected to 30 arcs. A face is a directed path forest (in/out degree ≤1, no cycles). Frozen verify_petersen_multipath.py contains two complete arc-set enumerators, full Hasse incidence acyclicity tests for ascending/descending toggle matchings, exact signed Morse boundary recursions, unit-pivot integral reductions with zero residual, and an unreduced mod-2 cross-check. It asserts Smith unit-only reductions giving tilde-H ranks (12,1,44,94) in degrees 4–7. Independent fresh exhaustive direct enumeration of all 59203 faces reproduced f_{-1..8}=(1,30,360,2240,7860,15912,18280,11160,3120,240), Euler −39=12−1+44−94. Integer Smith boundaries were examined but not fully re-executed. C is not affected by the decisive prior coverage.
